name: CaloChallenge photon shower generation
description: fit_showers(training) -> sampler(incident_energies, rng). Training contains showers, incident_energies and voxel geometry from official CaloChallenge Dataset 1 photons. Return nonnegative (event,voxel) deposits in MeV. Independent source-file events are held out. Score per-energy standardized Wasserstein of shower response, sparsity, layer fractions, centroids and widths. Classifier AUC and generation time are separate diagnostics. Compact CPU adaptation, not full challenge leaderboard.

papers.title: CaloFlow: Fast and Accurate Generation of Calorimeter Showers with Normalizing Flows
papers.task_relation: The local task generates nonnegative showers conditioned on photon energy using a CaloChallenge source dataset and a CPU-oriented feature-Wasserstein score. Those data, restrictions, and score do not reproduce the CaloFlow experiment.
papers.primary_goal: Accelerate calorimeter shower simulation while retaining realistic shower distributions and correlations.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Generate accurate conditional calorimeter showers at lower computational cost than detailed particle-transport simulation.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Fast, faithful detector-response simulation is the primary target of CaloFlow research.
science_relevance.reason: This is a direct proposed solution to detector simulation, replacing reliance on the CaloChallenge benchmark paper alone.
